copy.headline: Iconic toy retailer Toys 'R' Us opens holiday pop-up store in Fort Worth
copy.caption: Beloved toy store Toys "R" Us, the chain that sells toys, games, electronics, and gear, has debuted a pop-up shop in Fort Worth for the 2026 holiday season. According to a release, a Toys "R" Us store has opened at Tanger Outlets Fort Worth, 15853 N Fwy., Ste. 1140, in far north Fort Worth.
